from __future__ import annotations

"""Hard-failing R3 site-context, licensing, cartography, and CX audit.

The audit treats OpenStreetMap as a background-only, open-data-derived layer.
It never promotes the packaged snapshots into required design geometry.
"""

import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import lzma
from pathlib import Path


SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve()
ASSETS = SCRIPT.parent
SUB = SCRIPT.parents[2]
SOURCE_ID = "DATA-SRC-OSM-CONTEXT-20260828"
EXPECTED_RAW = {
    "corridor": "8dad196202f791ac49ecb353f45447539769b3baf877e716292b0acaacb3ac7c",
    "zhongzhiyuan": "51ec26b19c638cbd59d37a78d9bc3fc45fcb89eda891181cb025267331432fb7",
    "ai_origin": "471e7ae53d7cd0c16d683c478b9e4c32a8062d1ae5c3a74b1bb5c733a29d3d0c",
    "dazhongsi": "4b658b531b8154593bd19e6a99d540d9b1105c8e3c25a3a4673c10777b4fd84e",
}
EXPECTED_QUERY = {
    "corridor": "7b1218caafbd303d3201ceda6dab59f9fccd780b296653e1fe58f228e1e3edb1",
    "zhongzhiyuan": "be607fa06fb745e9245d5770c469e59d8c434550d238ab83bf1356b78e7a9953",
    "ai_origin": "ebc8170073c7524e579bf3e90cecc61ba82a8a25ff1fe79ccc27997ce1fb3aac",
    "dazhongsi": "84c8b075f22b2070f84b376947f882d70392d20361fc5323b64208cb083ce2a4",
}
EXPECTED_R2_SOURCE_RECORD_HASHES = [
    "3cb653f765a0d532d831f22ad0463faa0da0482bd76a247c129255a54abbe9d8",
    "f19acd4f2dc78a2f5490529641652487f9c8f64395753e6d26aded58fb26eb32",
    "6ee3c705c06cdce60f5c36a3809fa2e33f63cf3ed4d6e4fae97c8ecd4427a67f",
    "4abe5012fa4ec2ba4bfaf36fdf5d066407a7082422bfefd8d7645ee60a8f0493",
    "1d3733a3d7600636a1eefd84624bcd0735e7d26f6866a0c947545c10025305b3",
    "e6dd41560ebac70b4d57ccccf4472fe3bdd2d002b05569bedfbec92da52628e0",
    "486e0d8aaf279af7bcbe3e12feee7d8b26f41aec59014c944e618bdabda2c9fb",
    "461f3b1f74888574fce016260b01346e882a6c8cab4ea48b319ac8cdd4e2de77",
    "c5bc85ff0df50c44356bc4db96f77f9916b2436defb8047790d7270025e334b3",
    "4404b4cfd4038da3051d2658cfb1f6d7967242360b5948a97604c49603bc0417",
    "af005c267760ed44cc1ffb1b52ed068c26cacf9dc32e57228c4f551f7d8294ec",
    "7858e83500540c3460362e04e7fa4a8c7d6397d48fedcaac52b73a3922f6d1ec",
    "2c41c6c36c45497f01ba25f67d46c5541aedcea94c69dcca73ef09079b81b417",
    "8aec039bfc7de548d6f493a18e9eed2be29fab410c2403ef99eb657b7f7e1fe9",
    "923898ca30e0ede58826cfc97da6b60f85acfd4764ce276a1a12618e4136d8bb",
    "c6a0e159dec2d8bcaf6879199b9cf9ed9a1bf18214e7f34d7191f0be915451ae",
    "0657233f6cda96fd8c176bab38479e1300ffcc44f0ddca953de40c61e0dcf6ae",
    "203e70012f786e8d448c24d2e782031dd3f84d0de1a2bfd3e434795b26e388da",
    "0e182ea1aae3aaa4601578413b6dd1183c0aa227b2e5f0f9440f767419e5232e",
]
EXPECTED_GEOMETRY = {
    "geometry/buildings.geojson": "2f1643d5d22928ef62584ec8f2170624f2c3e02633f5b27508c700fc771c5795",
    "geometry/constraints.geojson": "1bcc539850e7bdb26655e6e3cc97235917ae235c0d8e6edbe5da629b772c937a",
    "geometry/green_space.geojson": "a3e132c65a67f974152b800e4700fc15e40355c68f837c843c4fdc90c164ce3b",
    "geometry/key_areas.geojson": "914cf53d4242a81cd445d8271e2718e3dc7750800d0da421688ed21425a09d23",
    "geometry/land_use.geojson": "d1db782861ac49c2ca4fb2cfb89998c8e29c7355c0c2d4dcda5f63d60f83454d",
    "geometry/phasing.geojson": "622d8cd4f38036bcef54633ae7393fa7d3ee119e05206d373d8c004e914c6429",
    "geometry/public_space.geojson": "63608b4d8bb39ee756ef01ba59f4cd31fb65828270fe0c70e0292c960732e852",
    "geometry/roads.geojson": "52eaf020fd0728169e707fc068dee0b908713dbb43d09ee525c30a3595c08fd3",
    "geometry/site_boundary.geojson": "a3ff9ef96c4ac626044a40b794e7868c2a3e4dafed466ed84665916ba31156fb",
}
EXPECTED_FIRST_USE = "Dazhongsi station arrival + heritage/retail edge -> candidate CX10 conflict -> SC10 + IM06 only -> Human Takeover; no evidenced Gate, no opening"


def sha_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def sha_file(path: Path) -> str:
    return sha_bytes(path.read_bytes())


def canonical_hash(value: object) -> str:
    return sha_bytes(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8"))


def load(path: Path) -> object:
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(message)


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--source-container", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--negative", choices=("raw-hash", "license", "authority", "scale", "missing-cx", "first-use", "label-overlap"))
    args = parser.parse_args()

    context = load(ASSETS / "r3-site-context.json")
    phase2 = load(ASSETS / "phase2-visual-generation-contract.json")
    freeze = load(ASSETS / "phase4-source-freeze.json")
    sources_doc = load(SUB / "sources.json")
    roads = load(SUB / "geometry/roads.geojson")

    if args.negative == "license":
        context["license"]["attribution_url"] = "https://invalid.example/"
    elif args.negative == "authority":
        context["authority"] = "formal"
    elif args.negative == "scale":
        phase2["r3_site_context"]["cartographic_assertions"][0]["actual_px"] += 7
    elif args.negative == "missing-cx":
        roads["features"] = [feature for feature in roads["features"] if feature["id"] != "CX12"]
    elif args.negative == "first-use":
        phase2["r3_site_context"]["unique_first_use_causal_path"] = "SC05 + IM06"
    elif args.negative == "label-overlap":
        phase2["r3_site_context"]["label_bbox_assertions"][0]["intersections"] = 1

    snapshot_results = []
    for name, expected_raw in EXPECTED_RAW.items():
        payload = load(ASSETS / f"r3-osm-{name}-snapshot.json")
        compressed = base64.b64decode(payload["raw_response"]["payload"])
        require(payload["raw_response"].get("encoding") == "xz+base64", f"{name}: XZ encoding")
        require(sha_bytes(compressed) == payload["raw_response"]["xz_sha256"], f"{name}: XZ hash")
        raw = lzma.decompress(compressed, format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ)
        if args.negative == "raw-hash" and name == "corridor":
            raw += b" "
        require(len(raw) == payload["raw_response"]["bytes"], f"{name}: raw byte count")
        require(sha_bytes(raw) == expected_raw == payload["raw_response"]["sha256"], f"{name}: raw hash")
        require(sha_bytes(payload["query_utf8"].encode("utf-8")) == EXPECTED_QUERY[name] == payload["query_sha256"], f"{name}: query hash")
        require(payload["source_id"] == SOURCE_ID, f"{name}: source id")
        require(payload["license"]["url"] == "https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/", f"{name}: ODbL URL")
        require(payload["license"]["attribution_url"] == "https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright", f"{name}: attribution URL")
        snapshot_results.append({"id": name, "package_sha256": sha_file(ASSETS / f"r3-osm-{name}-snapshot.json"), "raw_bytes": len(raw), "raw_sha256": sha_bytes(raw), "query_sha256": payload["query_sha256"], "osm_base_timestamp": payload["osm_base_timestamp"]})

    require(context["schema"] == "jingzhang-r3-osm-context/v1", "context schema")
    require(context["source_id"] == SOURCE_ID, "context source id")
    require(context["authority"] == "background_only" and context["status"] == "open-data-derived", "context authority")
    require(context["license"]["url"] == "https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/", "context ODbL URL")
    require(context["license"]["attribution_url"] == "https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright", "context attribution URL")
    require(context["projection"]["crs"] == "EPSG:4548" and context["projection"]["units"] == "m", "projection")
    separation = context["separation_contract"]
    require(separation["required_design_geojson_modified"] is False and separation["may_enter_required_geometry"] is False and separation["may_upgrade_existing_source_grade"] is False, "required-geometry separation")
    require(context["layer_contract"] == {"status": "open-data-derived", "source_id": SOURCE_ID, "feature_fields": ["osm_ref", "geometry_type", "coordinates_epsg4548_m", "tags", "site?"], "repeated_authority_fields_omitted_for_package_size": True}, "layer authority contract")
    for layer_name, layer in context["layers"].items():
        require(layer and context["counts"][layer_name] == len(layer), f"{layer_name}: count")
        require(all("status" not in item and "source_id" not in item and "layer" not in item and "id" not in item for item in layer), f"{layer_name}: repeated authority fields")
    require(len(context["landmarks"]) == 7 and len(context["site_labels"]) == 9, "cleared landmark labels")
    common = context["viewports"]["common_scale_key_areas"]
    require(set(common) == {"zhongzhiyuan", "ai_origin", "dazhongsi"}, "three key areas")
    require(all(value["width_m"] == 1000.0 and value["height_m"] == 650.0 for value in common.values()), "common 1000x650 m viewport")

    source_rows = sources_doc["sources"]
    require(len(source_rows) >= 20 and source_rows[19]["id"] == SOURCE_ID, "append-only source registry")
    actual_r2_hashes = [canonical_hash(item) for item in source_rows[:19]]
    require(actual_r2_hashes == EXPECTED_R2_SOURCE_RECORD_HASHES, "first 19 source records changed")
    source = dict(source_rows[19])
    stated_metadata_hash = source.pop("metadata_record_sha256")
    require(canonical_hash(source) == stated_metadata_hash, "OSM metadata record hash")
    require(source["authority_level"] == "BACKGROUND_ONLY" and source["evidence_grade"] == "background_only", "source grade")
    require(source["attribution_url"] == "https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright", "source attribution")
    require(len(source["content_hashes"]) == 6, "source content hashes")
    for record in source["content_hashes"]:
        require(sha_file(SUB / record["path"]) == record["sha256"], f"source content hash: {record['path']}")

    geometry_results = []
    for relative, expected in EXPECTED_GEOMETRY.items():
        actual = sha_file(SUB / relative)
        require(actual == expected, f"required design geometry drift: {relative}")
        geometry_results.append({"path": relative, "sha256": actual})

    cx = [feature for feature in roads["features"] if feature["id"].startswith("CX")]
    require([feature["id"] for feature in cx] == [f"CX{i:02d}" for i in range(1, 13)], "CX01-CX12 exact IDs")
    require(all(feature["properties"]["status"] == "candidate_not_surveyed" and feature["properties"]["surveyed"] is False for feature in cx), "CX status")

    r3 = phase2["r3_site_context"]
    cartography = r3["cartographic_assertions"]
    require(len(cartography) == 14, "bilingual cartography assertion count")
    for row in cartography:
        require(row["crs"] == "EPSG:4548" and row["north_up"] is True, f"{row['map_id']}: projection/north")
        recalculated = row["actual_px"] / row["px_per_m"]
        require(abs(recalculated - row["scale_bar_m"]) <= 0.05 and row["error_m"] <= 0.05, f"{row['map_id']}: scale bar")
    common_rows = r3["common_scale_assertions"]
    require(len(common_rows) == 6 and {row["language"] for row in common_rows} == {"zh", "en"}, "bilingual common-scale assertions")
    require(all(row["viewport_width_m"] == 1000.0 and row["viewport_height_m"] == 650.0 and row["px_per_m"] == 0.664 for row in common_rows), "same-scale values")
    labels = r3["label_bbox_assertions"]
    require(labels and sum(row["intersections"] for row in labels) == 0, "label bbox intersections")
    cx_labels = [row for row in labels if row["landmark"].startswith("CX")]
    for map_id in ("F01-corridor", "F02-corridor", "F04-corridor"):
        for language in ("zh", "en"):
            present = {row["landmark"] for row in cx_labels if row["map_id"] == map_id and row["language"] == language}
            require(present == {f"CX{i:02d}" for i in range(1, 13)}, f"{map_id}/{language}: all CX labels")
    for map_id, expected in (("F03-zhongzhiyuan", "CX02"), ("F03-ai_origin", "CX05"), ("F03-dazhongsi", "CX10")):
        for language in ("zh", "en"):
            require(any(row["map_id"] == map_id and row["language"] == language and row["landmark"] == expected for row in cx_labels), f"{map_id}/{language}: key CX label")
    require(r3["unique_first_use_causal_path"] == EXPECTED_FIRST_USE, "sole-first-use causal path")

    presentation = load(ASSETS / "phase4-generation-contract.json")["r3_site_context_contract"]
    require(presentation["authority"] == "background_only" and presentation["required_design_geojson_modified"] is False, "Phase4 background separation")
    require(presentation["unique_first_use"].startswith("Dazhongsi station + heritage/retail edge -> candidate CX10 -> SC10 + IM06 only -> Human Takeover"), "Phase4 sole-first-use path")
    require(freeze["r3_site_expression"]["background_source"]["required_geometry_separation"] is True, "source-freeze separation")
    require(freeze["r3_site_expression"]["cartographic_contract"]["key_area_shared_scale"] is True, "source-freeze common scale")

    result = {
        "schema": "jingzhang-r3-site-context-qa/v1",
        "ok": True,
        "authority": "internal deterministic QA; not official scoring, approval, or PDF/UA",
        "source_id": SOURCE_ID,
        "snapshots": snapshot_results,
        "source_registry": {"records": len(source_rows), "r3_frozen_prefix_records": 20, "appended_after_r3": len(source_rows) - 20, "r2_records_unchanged": 19, "metadata_record_sha256": stated_metadata_hash, "license": "ODbL-1.0", "authority": "background_only"},
        "required_design_geometry": {"files": geometry_results, "unchanged": True},
        "context": {"sha256": sha_file(ASSETS / "r3-site-context.json"), "projection": "EPSG:4548", "layer_counts": context["counts"], "landmarks": 7, "site_labels": 9, "required_design_geojson_modified": False},
        "cartography": {"assertions": len(cartography), "north_up": True, "scale_bar_max_error_m": max(row["error_m"] for row in cartography), "common_scale_assertions": len(common_rows), "key_area_viewport_m": [1000, 650], "key_area_px_per_m": 0.664},
        "labels": {"assertions": len(labels), "cx_assertions": len(cx_labels), "intersections": 0, "full_corridor_maps_with_cx01_12": ["F01", "F02", "F04"], "key_area_expected_cx": {"zhongzhiyuan": "CX02", "ai_origin": "CX05", "dazhongsi": "CX10"}},
        "sole_first_use": {"exact": EXPECTED_FIRST_USE, "human_takeover_visible": True, "no_evidenced_gate_no_opening": True},
        "negative_modes": ["raw-hash", "license", "authority", "scale", "missing-cx", "first-use", "label-overlap"],
        "retained_boundaries": "1 provisional site boundary; 3 KEY_AREA_PROVISIONAL; surveyed=0; 6 unknown metrics; 12 controller unknown; legal/accessibility/safety/site/operator/formal approval incomplete; frozen 12 vs authoritative 13 explanation retained; no PDF/UA claim.",
    }

    if args.negative:
        raise AssertionError(f"negative fixture unexpectedly passed: {args.negative}")
    if args.output:
        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    if args.source_container:
        source_text = SCRIPT.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
        container = {"schema": "jingzhang-r3-audit-source/v1", "language": "python", "restore_as": "r3-site-context-audit.py", "source_sha256": sha_bytes(source_text.encode("utf-8")), "source": source_text}
        args.source_container.write_text(json.dumps(container, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
